title: Expanded official-source and seven-gate Strict12 candidate readiness
source_upgrades: HMLR July 2026 publication, freehold subset, unique ID, title-plan and reprojection guards live-revalidated
EA DTM 1m terrain, ODN, OSTN15, WCS raw-pixel, persistent endpoint and NoData contracts live-revalidated
OS Terrain 50 annual July, exact 2858-tile/55-folder supply, raster geometry and unique-ID refresh semantics live-revalidated
OSTN15 horizontal and OSGM15 vertical transformation accuracy contracts live-revalidated
OS Downloads API keyless OpenData discovery, filtered download and redirect semantics live-revalidated
Strict12 expanded from four to seven explicit fail-closed promotion gates per candidate row
sources: EA WCS migration and NoData guidance
official_checks_rows: INSPIRE download page states publication on 5 July 2026.
New INSPIRE files are published on the first Sunday of every month.
Polygons are downloadable as separate local-authority files.
A GIS is required to view the downloaded GML polygons.
Download and reuse are governed by Open Government Licence conditions.
Each monthly publication represents data from the previous month.
The public dataset is a subset for registered freehold land and property.
The polygons show indicative position and extent rather than definitive legal extent.
Each polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID.
The INSPIRE ID relates to a registered title.
Definitive registered-title extent must be established from the individual title plan.
A polygon on a local-authority boundary may appear in both authority files.
The dataset is published as GML files.
HMLR geometries are captured against British National Grid.
Official guidance warns BNG-to-WGS84 reprojection may shift features by up to 15 metres.
The DTM represents terrain after surface objects are removed.
The composite DTM has 1 metre spatial resolution.
Official metadata states approximately 99 percent coverage of England.
Where repeat surveys exist, the newest best-resolution data is used.
Resampled source data uses bilinear interpolation.
The composite includes surveys from 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022.
The product is supplied as GeoTIFF raster tiles on a 5 km grid.
Tiles are aligned to the OS National Grid.
Elevation values are expressed in metres.
Heights are referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn.
Official metadata identifies OSTN15 as the transformation method.
The stated survey vertical accuracy is plus or minus 15 cm RMSE.
WCS provides raw pixel data such as elevation.
The yearless WCS endpoint is intended to remain persistent across updates.
OS Terrain 50 is an open digital terrain model product.
The product is updated annually in July.
The DTM primarily defines ground surface after protruding features are removed.
Grid points use regular 50 metre post spacing.
Grid and contour data are supplied as 10 km by 10 km tiles.
The national tiled supply contains exactly 2,858 tiles.
The 2,858 tiles are arranged into 55 100 km grid-square folders.
Online download is available without registration.
The grid supply is available as ASCII grid and GML 3.2.1.
Contours are supplied as Shapefile, GML, GeoPackage and vector tiles.
The OpenData product is free for commercial, educational and personal use.
Each ASCII raster row contains 200 pixels.
Each raster pixel is 50 metres by 50 metres.
Height values are supplied to the nearest 0.1 metre.
Feature identifiers are unique per release and updated tiles regenerate IDs by whole-tile refresh.
OSTN15 is the definitive transformation between ETRS89 and OSGB36.
OSTN15 uses a one kilometre transformation grid.
Point shifts are obtained using bilinear interpolation.
OSTN15-based coordinates agree on average better than 0.1 metre.
OSGM15 converts ETRS89 ellipsoid height to orthometric datum height.
On mainland Britain OSGM15 provides Ordnance Datum Newlyn heights.
OSGM15 uses the same one kilometre grid resolution as OSTN15.
The nominal geoid-model accuracy is 8 mm rms in mainland UK.
OS OpenData API operations do not require an API key.
Premium data-package endpoints require API key or OAuth2.
OpenData download lists can be filtered by filename, format, subformat and area.
A single matching download can return an HTTP 307 redirect when requested.
candidate_gate_templates: Unique official HMLR INSPIRE polygon identity is still required from Batch128 runtime materialization.
INSPIRE is indicative only; no definitive legal-boundary claim will be promoted without the title plan.
BNG/EPSG:27700 and OSTN15 contracts are verified; WGS84 shortcut matching is forbidden.
ODN and OSGM15 semantics are explicit and separated from horizontal CRS.
EA DTM raw-pixel sampling requires the existing execution host and canonical output files.
OS Terrain 50 cross-check requires the canonical runtime tile and readback chain.
Numeric promotion remains forbidden until exact identity, runtime sampling and remote acceptance seals exist.
